title: qa-run-case case-run.json — agentic case-run receipt
description: The ratified output of the qa-run-case skill, written to <evid_root>/<key>/case-run.json. The runner returns this object verbatim to the control plane; the control plane branches on `status`, stores the raw grade and the drift on the run record, maps `steps` to per-step rows, and PROPOSES a verdict a human disposes at the verdict gate. This file is the single source of truth for the runner and the control plane. See contracts/README.md. The case grade is the FULL five-value vocabulary PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL|BLOCKED|MANUAL, plus an orthogonal `drift[]` label-drift signal and an optional best-effort `media[]`. Vocabulary bridge (control-plane side): PASS->(passed,pass); FAIL->(failed,fail); BLOCKED->(failed + 'BLOCKED:' marker -> blocked); PARTIAL->(failed + 'PARTIAL:' marker -> needs_review); MANUAL->(error + 'MANUAL:' marker -> needs_review); off-enum->(error, needs_review). Marker precedence: BLOCKED: wins over PARTIAL:/MANUAL:. Per-step: PASS->passed, FAIL|BLOCKED->failed, INFO->skipped.

status.description: The case grade — the field the control plane branches on. PASS = every verify held, mutations confirmed by an independent read, no console errors. FAIL = a verify failed or a target couldn't be found after the alternate-phrasing retry. PARTIAL = mutation succeeded but a side-assertion drifted (proposes needs_review). BLOCKED = a precondition couldn't be satisfied — the headless escape hatch for every place the source skill would have asked a human (proposes blocked). MANUAL = needs human judgment (all steps manual-check, template-only, or subjective) (proposes needs_review).

summary.description: One honest line describing the outcome. For FAIL/PARTIAL, quote the mismatch verbatim (never a paraphrase). For BLOCKED, state the exact blocking reason.

steps.description: One row per executed step, in order. Maps to per-step rows on the control plane (status: PASS->passed, FAIL|BLOCKED->failed, INFO->skipped).

n.description: The step number from the case's steps_structured (1-based).

status.description: Per-step grade. PASS = the step's expected result held. FAIL = it did not. INFO = a non-asserting step (navigate/click/type/manual-check note) -> mapped to skipped. BLOCKED = the step couldn't run (precondition/driver).

observation.description: What was actually observed on the truth channel (verbatim value, not a toast). Empty string allowed for pure action steps.

failed_steps.description: The `n` of every FAIL step (a convenience index; the authoritative per-step grade is in `steps`).

manual_steps.description: The `n` of every step classified manual-check (needs human judgment).

drift.description: OPTIONAL. Label-drift entries — orthogonal to `status`, a flag not a grade. One entry per step where the case source's expected label was stale but a semantic-equivalent locator matched (the case still passed functionally). Stored beside the grade on the run record.

step.description: The step number the drift was observed on.

expected_label.description: The verbatim label the case expected.

observed_label.description: The label the UI actually rendered / the locator that matched.

locator.description: OPTIONAL. The fallback locator strategy that hit (e.g. getByText).

verb.description: OPTIONAL. The step verb (click | select | verify).

media.description: OPTIONAL, best-effort. Capture-time evidence media uploaded through the evidence_store adapter, each a URL the control plane fetches directly (a signed read URL or a local file:// URL — no Authorization header). Omitted entirely when upload is not configured or failed — media is NEVER required, so an artifact without this key still validates. Maps to record artifacts [{kind, name: label, url}].

kind.description: What the media is: a run recording (gif/mp4) or an uploaded screenshot.

url.description: The URL exactly as the evidence_store adapter returned it (a signed read URL, or a local file:// URL from the `local` provider). Fetchable with no Authorization header.

label.description: OPTIONAL human label, e.g. 'Full run — MP4'.

notes.description: OPTIONAL free-form notes (flakiness observed, environment oddities, follow-ups).
